fee_model.charged_on: entry taker and early (marked) exit taker; no fee on settlement exit
fee_model.verified: formula reproduced against all 21 rows of the official PDF table (see fee_verification)
fee_model.unverified: whether the demo environment actually charges fees

fill_model.rule: single fill price = candle price.close_dollars (last traded YES price)
fill_model.spread_reported: yes_ask.close - yes_bid.close, reported as execution-cost estimate and NOT applied to fills
fill_model.skipped: candles without a traded price are skipped; no fill is invented

exit_model.mark: recorded traded YES price at the horizon candle (marked, not settled)

topic_attribution.rule: topic taken from the committed settled snapshot, else from the committed open-market snapshot; markets in neither stay 'unknown' (never inferred)
